item.title: Travis Perkins strengthens balance sheet as turnaround takes early hold
item.summary: Travis Perkins shares jumped on Tuesday after the company reported a resilient first half and a much-strengthened balance sheet, as its new chief executive’s turnaround of the building materials group began to show early signs of progress.
